about:
# ForeverAuras
ForeverAuras is a powerful and flexible framework that allows the display of highly customizable graphics on World of Warcraft's user interface to indicate buffs, debuffs, and other relevant information. This addon was created to be a replacement for WeakAuras2 in WoW Forever.

## Quick Start
To open the options window, type `/fa` or `/foreverauras` into your chat and hit enter or use the minimap icon.

## FAQ
### Q: I thought Blizzard disabled addons for WoW Forever just like Retail?
*A: Addons are not disabled they just work differently now. There are "Secret" APIs which cannot be controlled by addons. Blizzard controls these APIs but Addons can tell them how to be displayed through the Blizzard CDM (Cooldown Manager). To see Blizzard's CDM, type `/cdm` in game chat.*

### Q: What is the Blizzard Cooldown Manager (CDM)?
*A: The CDM in WoW Forever is intended to enhance gameplay by pulling critical information from the buff bar or action bar and placing it in a fully customizable location. By default, the Cooldown Manager is disabled, and it can be enabled in Options under the Gameplay Enhancement settings.*

### Q: I thought WeakAuras are dead. Why should I download ForeverAuras?
*A: WeakAuras is only "dead" because the WA devs have decided not to update the addon.
Myself and a few others have spent a considerable amount of time to update the WeakAuras addon to work in WoW Forever. This is posted as a new addon [ForeverAuras](https://github.com/neroxrw/foreverauras/blob/main/%5Bhttps%3A/www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/foreverauras%5D%28https%3A/www.curseforge.com/wow/addons/foreverauras%29) and follows the license posted by WeakAuras.*

### Q: Will my old WeakAuras imports work in ForeverAuras?
*A: It depends on what the WeakAura is doing. Certain things are no longer accessible in Combat but most out of combat WeakAuras should work.*

### Q: I have a question about how to accomplish something in the ForeverAuras addon
*A: You can ask the community for help in our Discord. The Discord link is in the footer of the in-game addon.*

### Q: What's up with Modern Auras not being able to do `xyz`?
*A: Think of a Modern aura icon as a picture the game draws for you, not one the addon draws. During a fight, the game locks that picture: addons can look at it but can't touch it. So anything the addon figures out on its own (like "you're out of range") can't be painted onto that icon until the fight ends, and that's when it catches up.*

*The only exceptions are the 'Aura Active' conditions, because the game itself paints those when it draws the icon.*

*Old-style (Legacy) icons are drawn by the addon, so those can be recolored mid-fight, but they can't see auras in combat anymore, which is why you switched to Modern in the first place. You can't have both on one icon. The workaround is a second, addon-drawn thing laid over the top, like a red square that appears when you're out of range. This is what still makes ForeverAuras incredibly strong and powerful compared to any other aura displaying mechanism; the Addon still allows for complete customization; you just need to understand the limitations.*

## Acknowledgements

releases.notes:
## 1.4.18
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/neroxrw/foreverauras/pull/230)
- Fixed a Modern Aura Group sometimes losing its position between pulls while the game continued to restrict aura information.
- Bar ticks have a new "Force pixel perfect scale" option, so a tick can stay exactly one pixel wide on a scaled bar.
- Fixed Spell Usable icons sometimes showing that a spell could be cast when only a lower rank was affordable. Usability now follows the selected rank and spell override settings.

## 1.4.16
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/neroxrw/foreverauras/pull/228/changes)
- Spell cooldown icons set to Show Always now keep their picture when the game withholds cooldown timing
- Fixed Modern icons, bars, texts and group members sometimes staying blank when combat started right after closing the options window
- Fixed a Modern Show Always icon sometimes losing its "missing" picture when restrictions began just as the options window closed
- Fixed a half-transparent Modern Show Always icon drawing its live icon fainter than its "missing" picture
- Fixed leftover frames after changing a Modern icon from Always to Aura(s) Found in the options
- Cooldown Ready alerts are more accurate
- Action icons update more reliably when the game reports a spell's cooldown twice in the same moment
- Removing a trinket or other equipped item no longer makes equipment cooldown displays refresh over and over
- Small efficiency improvements

## 1.4.15
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/neroxrw/foreverauras/pull/224/changes)
- Fixed the game slowly getting heavier during a session after browsing aura groups in the options window
- Reduced the work done when many enemy nameplates appear at once, and spread the remaining setup over a few frames to soften the stutter on big pulls
- Fixed "weapon enchant missing" icons sometimes showing wrongly after a loading screen, resurrection or reload while the enchant was still active. (Thanks to yusufdanis for the report and fix)
- Small efficiency improvements for buff, debuff and personal resource auras

## 1.4.14
- Modern Aura Groups that show your own buffs can now share their buff tracking between the icons in a row.
- Significant performance optimization

## 1.4.13
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/neroxrw/foreverauras/pull/221/changes)
- Fixed combo point displays showing the previous target's points after switching or clearing your target. Combo points now follow your current target. (Thanks protella)
- Fixed an error that could appear in combat when an aura with a glow showed. (Thanks Michael)

## 1.4.12
- ForeverAuras now uses official LibSpecialization

## 1.4.10
- Spell cooldown tracking now does less repeated work behind the scenes, including during combat

## 1.4.9
- Fixed icons in Modern Aura Groups sometimes missing their border the first time a buff appeared after a reload.
- Fixed icons in centered Modern Aura Groups missing their border when you reloaded with the buff already active. They now sort themselves out a few seconds after loading. If you reload in the middle of a fight, this happens when the fight ends.
- Fixed a small gap between icons in scaled groups that grow to the right.
- Shaman: totem icons now show in combat, including all four totems placed by Call of the Elements.
- Less stutter when entering and leaving combat, and when many enemy nameplates disappear at once.

## 1.4.8
[Full Changelog](https://github.com/neroxrw/foreverauras/pull/215/changes)
- Modern Aura Groups: this version is mostly fixes for how icons line up in a row.
- Fixed a wide empty space appearing in a row right after importing a group. Before, it stayed until you reloaded.
- Fixed the icon picture sticking out one pixel past its border on scaled groups.
- Fixed centered rows with spacing 0 showing a small gap, or one squashed icon, with some numbers of icons.
- Fixed groups on the old layout with spacing 0 showing a one pixel gap between icons when the group is scaled.
- Reloading in the middle of a fight: groups on the new layout now show their icons straight away instead of staying empty.
- Reloading in the middle of a fight: anything that could not be put back during the fight now comes back by itself a few seconds later. You no longer need a second reload.
- Fixed icons with a Stack Count filter refusing to show on large or scaled screens (the "fill renders off its length" message).
